speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Actinic Keratosis. The description of a rough, sandpaper-like plaque on the dorsal hand of a sun-exposed 65-year-old female with a history of sunbathing is classic for this pre-malignant skin condition caused by chronic UV damage. No further tests are required as the clinical presentation is specific.
